server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Name shown to connecting players and, when enabled, in the public server browser.

server_description.title: Server Description
server_description.description: Description sent to the server browser.

bind_ip.title: Listen Address
bind_ip.description: Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all IPv4 network interfaces.

max_players.title: Player Limit
max_players.description: Maximum number of players connected at the same time.

discord_url.title: Discord Community URL
discord_url.description: Community link included in the server browser entry.

steam_workshop_url.title: Workshop Collection URL
steam_workshop_url.description: Workshop link included in the server browser entry; this does not install mods.

display_chat_in_console.title: Show Chat in Console
display_chat_in_console.description: Includes player chat messages in the server console.

use_upnp.title: Automatic Router Port Mapping
use_upnp.description: Requests a port mapping from a router that supports UPnP.

sync_local_save.title: Allow Client Saves
sync_local_save.description: Allows a player to use their local save when connecting. When disabled, the server requires its own saved copy.

enable_server_browser.title: Public Server Listing
enable_server_browser.description: Lists the server publicly. Server telemetry must also be enabled; disabling this option alone keeps telemetry connected in private mode.

enable_server_telemetry.title: Server Browser Telemetry
enable_server_telemetry.description: Sends server details, address, population, mod list and player names to the browser service. Disabling this also disables public discovery.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Use printable ASCII without spaces. Written as an uppercase SHA256 digest to PasswordConfig.json. Leave unset to preserve an existing native password; explicitly clear to allow open access. Instances that previously enabled whitelists require a password before starting. Original whitelist data is preserved.

chat_enable_mo_td.title: Show Welcome Message
chat_enable_mo_td.description: Sends the message of the day to players when they connect.

chat_message_of_the_day.title: Welcome Message
chat_message_of_the_day.description: Message sent on connection when welcome messages are enabled.

difficulty_is_difficulty_enforced.title: Enforce Server Difficulty
difficulty_is_difficulty_enforced.description: Applies the server's difficulty settings to connected clients. The difficulty values below take effect only while this is enabled.

difficulty_threat_scale.title: Threat Scale
difficulty_threat_scale.description: Scales the strength of threats generated by the storyteller.

difficulty_allow_big_threats.title: Allow Major Threats
difficulty_allow_big_threats.description: Allows major hostile incidents such as raids.

difficulty_allow_violent_quests.title: Allow Violent Quests
difficulty_allow_violent_quests.description: Allows quests that involve hostile combat.

difficulty_allow_intro_threats.title: Allow Introductory Threats
difficulty_allow_intro_threats.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AllowIntroThreats. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: true.

difficulty_predators_hunt_humanlikes.title: Predators Hunt Humanoids
difficulty_predators_hunt_humanlikes.description: Allows predators to choose humanlike pawns as prey.

difficulty_allow_extreme_weather_inciden.title: Allow Extreme Weather
difficulty_allow_extreme_weather_inciden.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AllowExtremeWeatherIncidents. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: true.

difficulty_crop_yield_factor.title: Crop Yield Multiplier
difficulty_crop_yield_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: CropYieldFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_mine_yield_factor.title: Mining Yield Multiplier
difficulty_mine_yield_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: MineYieldFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_butcher_yield_factor.title: Butchering Yield Multiplier
difficulty_butcher_yield_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: ButcherYieldFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_research_speed_factor.title: Research Speed Multiplier
difficulty_research_speed_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: ResearchSpeedFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_quest_reward_value_factor.title: Quest Reward Value Multiplier
difficulty_quest_reward_value_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: QuestRewardValueFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_raid_loot_points_factor.title: Raid Loot Value Multiplier
difficulty_raid_loot_points_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: RaidLootPointsFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_trade_price_factor_loss.title: Trade Price Disadvantage
difficulty_trade_price_factor_loss.description: Higher values make trading prices less favorable to the colony.

difficulty_maintenance_cost_factor.title: Maintenance Cost Multiplier
difficulty_maintenance_cost_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: MaintenanceCostFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_scaria_rot_chance.title: Scaria Corpse Rot Chance
difficulty_scaria_rot_chance.description: Chance that an animal with scaria leaves a rotten corpse; 0.6 means 60%.

difficulty_enemy_death_on_downed_chance_.title: Enemy Death on Downing Multiplier
difficulty_enemy_death_on_downed_chance_.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: EnemyDeathOnDownedChanceFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_colonist_mood_offset.title: Colonist Mood Offset
difficulty_colonist_mood_offset.description: Adds to or subtracts from colonist mood in mood points.

difficulty_food_poison_chance_factor.title: Food Poisoning Chance Multiplier
difficulty_food_poison_chance_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: FoodPoisonChanceFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_manhunter_chance_on_damage_fa.title: Manhunter Retaliation Chance Multiplier
difficulty_manhunter_chance_on_damage_fa.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: ManhunterChanceOnDamageFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_player_pawn_infection_chance_.title: Colonist Infection Chance Multiplier
difficulty_player_pawn_infection_chance_.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: PlayerPawnInfectionChanceFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_disease_interval_factor.title: Disease Interval Multiplier
difficulty_disease_interval_factor.description: Scales the interval between disease incidents; larger values mean longer intervals.

difficulty_enemy_reproduction_rate_facto.title: Enemy Reproduction Rate Multiplier
difficulty_enemy_reproduction_rate_facto.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: EnemyReproductionRateFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_deep_drill_infestation_chance.title: Deep Drill Infestation Chance Multiplier
difficulty_deep_drill_infestation_chance.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: DeepDrillInfestationChanceFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_friendly_fire_chance_factor.title: Friendly Fire Chance
difficulty_friendly_fire_chance_factor.description: Chance factor for friendly fire; 0.4 represents 40%.

difficulty_allow_instant_kill_chance.title: Colonist Instant Death Chance
difficulty_allow_instant_kill_chance.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AllowInstantKillChance. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_peaceful_temples.title: Peaceful Ancient Complexes
difficulty_peaceful_temples.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: PeacefulTemples. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: false.

difficulty_allow_cave_hives.title: Allow Cave Hives
difficulty_allow_cave_hives.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AllowCaveHives. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: true.

difficulty_unwavering_prisoners.title: Unwavering Prisoners
difficulty_unwavering_prisoners.description: Allows prisoners whose unwavering loyalty prevents normal recruitment.

difficulty_allow_traps.title: Allow Traps
difficulty_allow_traps.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AllowTraps. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: true.

difficulty_allow_turrets.title: Allow Turrets
difficulty_allow_turrets.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AllowTurrets. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: true.

difficulty_allow_mortars.title: Allow Mortars
difficulty_allow_mortars.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AllowMortars. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: true.

difficulty_classic_mortars.title: Classic Mortars
difficulty_classic_mortars.description: Uses the game's classic mortar rules.

difficulty_adaptation_effect_factor.title: Threat Adaptation Strength
difficulty_adaptation_effect_factor.description: Scales how strongly the storyteller's adaptation affects threat strength.

difficulty_adaptation_growth_rate_factor.title: Threat Adaptation Growth Rate
difficulty_adaptation_growth_rate_factor.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AdaptationGrowthRateFactorOverZero. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_fixed_wealth_mode.title: Wealth-independent Progression
difficulty_fixed_wealth_mode.description: Uses time-based threat progression instead of colony wealth.

difficulty_low_pop_conversion_boost.title: Low-population Recruitment Boost
difficulty_low_pop_conversion_boost.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: LowPopConversionBoost. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 3.0.

difficulty_no_babies_or_children.title: Disable Babies and Children
difficulty_no_babies_or_children.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: NoBabiesOrChildren. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: false.

difficulty_babies_are_healthy.title: Healthy Births
difficulty_babies_are_healthy.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: BabiesAreHealthy. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: false.

difficulty_child_raiders_allowed.title: Allow Child Raiders
difficulty_child_raiders_allowed.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: ChildRaidersAllowed. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: false.

difficulty_child_aging_rate.title: Child Aging Rate
difficulty_child_aging_rate.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: ChildAgingRate. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 4.0.

difficulty_adult_aging_rate.title: Adult Aging Rate
difficulty_adult_aging_rate.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: AdultAgingRate. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_wastepack_infestation_chance_.title: Wastepack Infestation Chance Multiplier
difficulty_wastepack_infestation_chance_.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: WastepackInfestationChanceFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

difficulty_nomadic_mineable_resources_fa.title: Nomadic Mining Resources Multiplier
difficulty_nomadic_mineable_resources_fa.description: Optional override of Configs/DifficultyConfig.json: NomadicMineableResourcesFactor. When unset, existing native values remain unchanged. Native default: 1.0.

scenario_is_enforced.title: Enforce Server Scenario
scenario_is_enforced.description: Applies the server's saved starting scenario to clients.

scenario_name.title: Scenario Name
scenario_name.description: Name of the server's saved scenario; the name alone does not define its scenario parts.

storyteller_is_enforced.title: Enforce Server Storyteller
storyteller_is_enforced.description: Applies the server's selected storyteller to clients.

storyteller_def_name.title: Storyteller Definition ID
storyteller_def_name.description: Internal storyteller DefName, such as Cassandra or Randy; it is not the translated display name.

action_aid_is_enabled.title: Allow Player Aid
action_aid_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to send aid to other players. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_aid_cooldown.title: Player Aid Cooldown (ms)
action_aid_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between player aid requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_caravan_is_enabled.title: Allow Caravan Interaction
action_caravan_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to interact with other players' caravans. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_caravan_cooldown.title: Caravan Interaction Cooldown (ms)
action_caravan_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between caravan interaction requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_event_is_enabled.title: Allow Player Events
action_event_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to send events to other players. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_event_cooldown.title: Player Events Cooldown (ms)
action_event_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between player events requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_guild_is_enabled.title: Allow Guild Actions
action_guild_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to use guild actions. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_guild_cooldown.title: Guild Actions Cooldown (ms)
action_guild_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between guild actions requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_leaderboard_is_enabled.title: Allow Leaderboard Requests
action_leaderboard_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to request leaderboard data. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_leaderboard_cooldown.title: Leaderboard Requests Cooldown (ms)
action_leaderboard_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between leaderboard requests requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_market_is_enabled.title: Allow Market Trading
action_market_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to use the shared player market. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_market_cooldown.title: Market Trading Cooldown (ms)
action_market_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between market trading requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_market_minimum_price.title: Minimum Market Purchase Price
action_market_minimum_price.description: Used when an item's base price is below this value; otherwise the purchase markup applies.

action_market_price_multiplier.title: Market Price Spread
action_market_price_multiplier.description: For value x, the normal purchase price is base × (1 + x); seller proceeds are base ÷ (1 + 2x), truncated to integers. The minimum purchase price is separate.

action_market_max_entries_per_player.title: Market Listings per Player
action_market_max_entries_per_player.description: Maximum number of simultaneous listings owned by one player.

action_pollution_is_enabled.title: Allow Pollution Transfer
action_pollution_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to send pollution to other settlements. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_pollution_cooldown.title: Pollution Transfer Cooldown (ms)
action_pollution_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between pollution transfer requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_raid_is_enabled.title: Allow Player Raids
action_raid_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to raid other players' settlements. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_raid_cooldown.title: Player Raids Cooldown (ms)
action_raid_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between player raids requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_river_is_enabled.title: Allow River Editing
action_river_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to add or remove rivers on the world map. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_river_cooldown.title: River Editing Cooldown (ms)
action_river_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between river editing requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_road_is_enabled.title: Allow Road Construction
action_road_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to add or remove roads on the world map. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_road_cooldown.title: Road Construction Cooldown (ms)
action_road_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between road construction requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_road_allow_dirt_path.title: Allow Dirt Path
action_road_allow_dirt_path.description: Offers dirt path in the road construction menu.

action_road_allow_dirt_road.title: Allow Dirt Road
action_road_allow_dirt_road.description: Offers dirt road in the road construction menu.

action_road_allow_stone_road.title: Allow Stone Road
action_road_allow_stone_road.description: Offers stone road in the road construction menu.

action_road_allow_asphalt_path.title: Allow Asphalt Road
action_road_allow_asphalt_path.description: Offers asphalt road in the road construction menu.

action_road_allow_asphalt_highway.title: Allow Asphalt Highway
action_road_allow_asphalt_highway.description: Offers asphalt highway in the road construction menu.

action_road_dirt_path_cost.title: Dirt Path Cost (silver)
action_road_dirt_path_cost.description: Silver removed from the caravan when constructing this road type at its current world tile.

action_road_dirt_road_cost.title: Dirt Road Cost (silver)
action_road_dirt_road_cost.description: Silver removed from the caravan when constructing this road type at its current world tile.

action_road_stone_road_cost.title: Stone Road Cost (silver)
action_road_stone_road_cost.description: Silver removed from the caravan when constructing this road type at its current world tile.

action_road_asphalt_path_cost.title: Asphalt Road Cost (silver)
action_road_asphalt_path_cost.description: Silver removed from the caravan when constructing this road type at its current world tile.

action_road_asphalt_highway_cost.title: Asphalt Highway Cost (silver)
action_road_asphalt_highway_cost.description: Silver removed from the caravan when constructing this road type at its current world tile.

action_road_dirt_path_multiplier.title: Dirt Path Movement Difficulty Multiplier
action_road_dirt_path_multiplier.description: Multiplies world-map movement difficulty on this road. Lower values make travel faster.

action_road_dirt_road_multiplier.title: Dirt Road Movement Difficulty Multiplier
action_road_dirt_road_multiplier.description: Multiplies world-map movement difficulty on this road. Lower values make travel faster.

action_road_stone_road_multiplier.title: Stone Road Movement Difficulty Multiplier
action_road_stone_road_multiplier.description: Multiplies world-map movement difficulty on this road. Lower values make travel faster.

action_road_asphalt_path_multiplier.title: Asphalt Road Movement Difficulty Multiplier
action_road_asphalt_path_multiplier.description: Multiplies world-map movement difficulty on this road. Lower values make travel faster.

action_road_asphalt_highway_multiplier.title: Asphalt Highway Movement Difficulty Multiplier
action_road_asphalt_highway_multiplier.description: Multiplies world-map movement difficulty on this road. Lower values make travel faster.

action_scenario_is_enabled.title: Allow Custom Scenarios
action_scenario_is_enabled.description: Allows clients to open the scenario editor and select custom scenarios. This is separate from enforcing the server scenario.

action_scenario_cooldown.title: Scenario Cooldown (ms)
action_scenario_cooldown.description: Stored in Scenario.json, but version 26.8.31.1 does not apply this cooldown to scenario selection.

action_site_is_enabled.title: Allow Player Sites
action_site_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to manage sites on the world map. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_site_cooldown.title: Player Sites Cooldown (ms)
action_site_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between player sites requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_site_time_interval.title: Site Reward Interval (ms)
action_site_time_interval.description: Interval between client requests for site rewards; 1800000 ms is 30 minutes.

action_site_building_cost.title: Site Construction Cost (silver)
action_site_building_cost.description: Silver removed from the caravan when building a site.

action_site_rewards_count.title: Reward per Worked Site (silver)
action_site_rewards_count.description: Silver awarded for each eligible player or guild site with a worker.

action_trade_is_enabled.title: Allow Direct Player Trading
action_trade_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to trade directly with other players. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_trade_cooldown.title: Direct Player Trading Cooldown (ms)
action_trade_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between direct player trading requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_world_object_is_enabled.title: Allow World Map Objects
action_world_object_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to add or remove shared world objects. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_world_object_cooldown.title: World Map Objects Cooldown (ms)
action_world_object_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between world map objects requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.

action_zoom_is_enabled.title: Allow Settlement Map Preview
action_zoom_is_enabled.description: Allows ordinary players to request another settlement's map for viewing. Server administrators bypass this restriction.

action_zoom_cooldown.title: Settlement Map Preview Cooldown (ms)
action_zoom_cooldown.description: Minimum interval between settlement map preview requests from one ordinary player. 1000 ms is one second; administrators bypass this cooldown.
